g.text: P118: ordinary one-summary control and full history
Four known development tasks; one run per condition. All eight slots retained. Cached input counts as input.
Summary costs include rejected summaries. Unknown use is not zero; missing slots are not free runs.
A lower cost alone does not establish preserved quality. This is an ordinary-control comparison.
